text: いあいぎりを　つかえば　ほそい　きも　きれる！

structure.jp: いあいぎりを　つかえば
ほそい　きも　きれる！
structure.en: you can cut even thin trees!

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.explanation: The ば ending on a verb means 'if'. つかえば = 'if you use it'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing the last sound of a verb like きる to the え-row plus る says it can be done. きれる = 'can cut'.

patterns.name: 〜も (even)
patterns.explanation: も here means 'even', stressing something you might not expect. ほそい きも = 'even thin trees'.
